legacy_formula.stat: P99 of per-job contributions per cabinet (JOB/EVENT-WEIGHTED, not time-weighted)
legacy_formula.weighting: Each job contributes one observation regardless of job duration. P99 is over job-count observations, not time bins.
legacy_formula.topology: CORRECT (native array zip, fixed from earlier bug)

key_distinction_verbatim: The legacy P99 reference and the replayed concurrent cabinet quantity are not the same statistical object. The legacy reference is a marginal P99 over individual job contributions — each job contributes one observation, so it is EVENT-WEIGHTED (job-weighted), not time-weighted. The replayed concurrent quantity P_c_total(t) = sum_j P_job,c(t) over overlapping jobs is a time-varying sum; taking its P99 over time gives a TIME-WEIGHTED estimator of the concurrent power ceiling. These are different estimators and will generally differ. The legacy estimator is used in all sc0-sc54 results.

e1_behavior.application: CAB_SCALE multiplies each cabinet P99 uniformly; B_cab denominator scales proportionally
e1_behavior.note: E1 tests uniform mis-estimation of cabinet P99 ceiling, not T_thr or physical power budget
